The agent therefore validated altered fixtures and missed the actual required batch semantics.

failure.requirement: Process all valid authenticated transactions correctly: clean generated batches must have zero rejections, and malformed frames must be retained as rejections without causing valid transactions to be dropped.
failure.instruction_quote: Authenticate each frame before interpreting its contents or changing reconciliation state. Distinguish clean end-of-file, truncated length, truncated frame, invalid lengths, unsupported data, malformed fields, wrong rotations, duplicate references, duplicate adjustments, and unknown adjustment targets, and retain every rejection in the report.
failure.explanation: The replacement parser was incomplete or inconsistent with the documented frame protocol: it produced spurious rejections for otherwise valid normal, reordered, edge, and rotation batches, and dropped four valid transactions when processing the malformed batch. The agent stopped after custom fixtures and performance checks (steps 6-8) rather than running the supplied generator modes or validating the required rejection classifications, so its claim of completion was also inadequately verified.
